character.description: The same young adult nonbinary explorer anime protagonist in every scene: deep teal hair in a high braided knot, luminous amber-green eyes, with a distinctive, recognizable face and consistent adult proportions. Character identity: an exobiologist mapping bioluminescent forests beneath twin suns. Signature costume: a lightweight teal exploration suit with translucent leaf-pattern mantle and sealed field boots. Defining personal item: a wrist-mounted xenoflora scanner with softly glowing spores. Keep the exact face, hair shape and color, eye color, body proportions, costume silhouette, and signature item unchanged throughout the entire music video.
consistency_rules: This theme has one fixed protagonist: preserve the exact character identity in every scene.
Keep the same face, age impression, hairstyle, hair color, eye color, and body proportions.
Keep the signature costume silhouette, materials, colors, and defining personal item consistent; do not randomly redesign the outfit.
Do not replace the protagonist or introduce another lead character unless the lyrics explicitly require it.

visual_language.action_style: expressive, readable full-body gestures; natural movement; clear pose silhouettes; avoid static repeated poses
visual_language.environment_style: rich anime background design rooted in forest of giant glowing plants, cliffs of floating rocks, bioluminescent river; preserve the theme's distinctive world and recognizable environmental details
visual_language.lighting_style: cinematic lighting harmonized with alien teal, magenta, lime glow, violet; coherent light direction, atmospheric depth, and controlled highlights
visual_language.composition_style: varied cinematic framing informed by slow glide through glowing flora, wide shot of a forest with two suns, low shot of drifting spores; clear subject separation and intentional negative space
